topic: What happens if you laugh every day?
title: What daily laughter does
hook: What happens if you laugh every day?

beats.line: A big, hearty laugh gets your heart and lungs working harder.
Afterward, your heart rate settles, and your muscles relax.
Your brain releases endorphins, your body's feel-good chemicals.
Over time, laughing often can ease stress and lift your mood.
Laughing with friends can even help you handle pain better.

end.line: Who makes you laugh the most?

description: Five things a good daily laugh does for your heart, muscles, brain, mood and even pain.

facts.claim: Laughter increases intake of oxygen-rich air and stimulates the heart, lungs and muscles.
A good laugh raises and then lowers heart rate and blood pressure, leaving a relaxed feeling, and aids muscle relaxation.
Laughter increases endorphins released by the brain; PET imaging showed social laughter releases the body's own opioids.
facts.source: Mayo Clinic / Manninen et al., J Neurosci 2017

facts.claim: Over time, laughter can help lessen stress, depression and anxiety and may improve mood.
In experiments, social laughter raised people's pain thresholds; laughter may ease pain.
facts.source: Dunbar et al., Proc R Soc B 2012 / Mayo Clinic
